about: Single MEP element edits (mep.add, mep.move, mep.resize, mep.delete, mep.set; Q6502) and how the build joins ducts, pipes, air terminals, sprinkler heads and equipment so bim.chain can walk them. Each number with its basis.
match_basis: company default: an element read again within a foot of where an edit found it is the same element (a single-line plan read again lands within inches of its last reading)
equipment_basis: trade practice: a duct or pipe that ends at a unit's casing, or within a foot of it (its flexible connector, its valve set), is connected to it
terminal_basis: trade practice (tradepractice.json M-BRANCH-DUCT): an air terminal is fed by a branch duct off the nearest duct of its system within the rule's connect reach
sprinkler_basis: trade practice (NFPA 13 armovers, sprigs and drops): a head is fed from the branch line of its system it stands within two feet of
unconnected_basis: electrical distribution gear is fed by its feeders (bim.chain walks them), never by a duct or pipe that passes it
terminal_size_basis: company default: the size the plan readers give a terminal symbol that prints none
sprinkler_size_basis: company default: a head's half-inch connection
